objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, or work instructions, subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation prefix combined with a consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document (e.g., editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tracking successive revisions of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is considered valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus the validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies to which the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT application references maintained as document metadata.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational scopes to which the document is assigned.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled supplementary document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning but released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment tracking its own revision history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the attachment aligned with the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the additional information has been directly published via properties switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for change to an existing released document, managed independently without affecting the document version until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expiration, triggering a workflow to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request to invalidate a document and initiate the archiving process, triggering an approval workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person in the system who can be assigned roles and participate in document lifecycle workflows.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Named group of users used to assign read authorizations, distribution membership, and role-based access to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document controlling email notification and acknowledgement distribution upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance guiding document approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement through defined steps.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type used when creating new documents, supporting TAG-based metadata insertion.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational entity to which documents can be linked for structured filing and scoping.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Tenant or organizational instance in a multi-client system where document visibility can be configured.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific user interface view listing relevant documents, acknowledgements, and evaluation reports for a user.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Author creates a new document by attaching a new information object with a selected document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Author or co-author edits the content of a document using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Author or co-author maintains or modifies the metadata and attributes of a document in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: System automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow confirming authorship.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness during the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible and available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: System automatically publishes the document to readers after release.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: System creates a new editing version of a released document when content changes, attachment changes, or change proposals are implemented.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Author adds a controlled attachment to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Author or co-author modifies an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Author adds additional information to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Author deletes additional information from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: User with author rights creates a change proposal for a released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Author schedules a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of the change proposal and marks it as completed.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System generates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's valid until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Releaser or release participants confirm the document's continued validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: User with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a document.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Releaser or workflow participants approve the override request, setting the document status to out of force.

evts.name: revoke_authorizations
evts.description: System revokes all authorizations except archive group upon document invalidation.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Business Admin group member creates a request for reactivation for an invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document and restoring authorizations and distribution list.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: System sends email notification to distribution list members upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: System sends acknowledgement request emails to distribution list members upon release, requiring active confirmation.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Author or administrator assigns read or write authorizations to user groups or persons on a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Reviewer checks the translated document content.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Releaser approves and releases the translated language version of the document.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: System physically deletes an archived document after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: Attachment is a controlled supplementary object linked to and released with its main document.
Additional info is a supplementary object linked to a document without affecting its release cycle.
Change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
Request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
Request for override is linked to the document being invalidated.
Request for reactivation references the invalidated document to be reactivated.
One or more document templates are defined per document type and selected when creating new documents.
Documents can reference other documents through the References attribute for cross-linking.
Documents can be linked to organizational units for process-specific or structure-based filing.
Document visibility can be configured per client in a multi-client system.
Distribution list is maintained per document to control notification and acknowledgement distribution.
Users are assigned to user groups to receive role-based authorizations and distribution access.
Distribution list contains user groups whose members receive distribution notifications.
Distribution list can contain individual persons in addition to user groups.
